nom: SUNGBOON EDITOR Green Tomato Pore Lifting Ampoule Toner

avis.texte: I have had this annoying problems with pimples only on my nose. If I put any kind of product on my nose I will get small white heads in a matter of days. I read a review from someone who had the same issue and they said they were not breaking out anymore after using this. So I though I'd give it a try. I have been using this for a couple of weeks now along with their collagen serum. My skin looks so much better! Pores are smaller, skin is smoother and NO PIMPLES! I'm a male in my sixties and in exteremly good shape and feel my face should match! Don't have to ask my wife to use her skincare anymore Highly recommed. If it works on me it should be amazing for younger people.

I adore this product and use it after each shower. It's so nice to help moisturize my skin and help minimize pores as well. It does seem to make my skin appear a bit brighter and younger looking. There's a mild, but pleasant scent. I'm very sensitive to smells but I didn't find this bothersome at all. Definitely a product I've recommended to my friends.

avis.titre: Its a good product . Not sure if its as effective as advertised
avis.texte: I have no complaints about this product. No irritation whatsoever. Like the consistency and the fact that it quickly absorbs in the skin. After using this for a month now, I can't observe any discernible improvement in my pores. No complaints about this product. I think there are other products that could be more effective. I don't think I"ll purchase this product again
Sungboon is a great brand.. I love this serum. It helped my pores so much... made my skin so smooth glowing hydration... I love the scent. Helped with my uneven skin tone. No stickiness.

avis.titre: it works... i will order again
avis.texte: I was so excited to test it out so i bought. i have big pores not matter what, some made it worse by my cystic acne scars from my teenage years. Some days they look worse than others and I have done hundreds of skincare and procedures to my skin... I didn't receive it first round with bunch of my other goodies. They replaced it. Very grateful. I am now a loyal client. For the price, buy one and try it!!!! Besides my Clarins pore minimizer... it is a bit pricy, this one from Amazon is very affordable. Here is to looking good and feeling good. Make great little gifts too for your friends and family etc.
After using this on my skin for a week, I definitely noticed a change on my skin pores. I love the texture. I do recommend using it with your skin routine

avis.titre: Unfortunately, it caused redness and swelling on my face.
avis.texte: Unfortunately, it caused redness and swelling on my face. I would not recommend this product to anyone with sensitive skin.
I didn't really like the texture of the serum. I didn't see the advertised effect, even though I used it regularly.
I used only for 4 days I can see the changes in skin. It's really good for those who have small pores and lines on nose,cheeks and forehead. It's amazing 🤩

avis.titre: A fantastic serum - so impressed with the results!A fantastic serum - so impressed with the results!
avis.texte: I bought this serum after an influencer I trust with recommendations said it was the best serum they had ever used. For info, I have skin that is starting to get drier as I get older and I'm battling fine lines, and enlarged pores. It is fragrance free, lightweight and absorbs easily. The serum is light green in colour, but applies clear. I have used this every other night since purchasing and I have noticed a significant difference to my skin. The morning after using this serum, my skin feels smooth, hydrated and pores definitely appear smaller. You only need a few drops to cover your whole face - I use this after a toner so slightly damp skin. I use other serums and essences on top of this product and it doesnt pill or interfere with other products. I am really impressed with this serum - if your skin is like mine, I think you'll really enjoy it!

This pore cream doesn’t work miracles, but it does help reduce the appearance of pores a little. I like the product, but I saw an ad where a woman’s pores looked completely invisible—even though hers were larger than mine. Maybe I need a different product to achieve that effect, but this one does work, just not as perfectly as I’d hoped. I always make sure to cleanse my face thoroughly before applying it, which I think is essential. Until I find something better, I’ll keep using this cream to minimize my pores.

This helps my poresThis product has no scent. It helps with my wrinkles it absorbs very quickly it has a great effect on my skin after using it for a month. This is definitely one of my favorite products while doing my skin care routine

avis.titre: Green Tomato Magic: Pores, Be Gone!
avis.texte: I absolutely adore this Green Tomato Pore Lifting Ampoule! I've always been self-conscious about my pores, but ever since I started using this serum, those worries have vanished. It's like a little bottle of confidence for my skin.

This serum applies easily, absorbs quickly, no stickiness. The serum has a light scent, smells nice. The serum works well under makeup, my skin looked great! My pores were not invisible, but they were definitely less noticeable. Great value!

The green tomato seems to be pretty good for pore size. It helps with very large visible pores that hold a lot of sebum and are prone to breakout. After a while, it does feel a bit less oily and large. Not sure how long the affects would last and if products need to be used indefinitely but it does feel pretty good and easy to spread. It's a good moisturizer that does do a bit more than regular moisturizers so a good replacement if you want a bit more out of your routine

I cannot say I truly think this works because I believe it may take a little longer to show results. But I’ll keep using it as it didn’t not cause me any skin issues. My problem with this though and the reason I dropped a star is the scent. I don’t get why everything has to have a scent. But using this and then a moisturizer while usually has its own scent is just too overpowering. The flowery scent in this alone gives me a headache sometimes. For those who are sensitive to smells may want to avoid this.
